_doc: Source registry and compliance policy for catalogue imports. Nothing here is fetched unless a harvest command is run by a person on a networked machine. `termsReviewed` is false until the site owner has read the source's current terms; harvest refuses a source whose terms are unreviewed unless --accept-terms is passed.

policy.note: Descriptions and covers are not copied from any source; book pages use a factual summary built from verified fields unless an original description is supplied.

hostOwnerGroups._doc: Hosts under common ownership count as ONE source. Registrable domains are compared after stripping country suffixes (amazon.com and amazon.co.uk are one source).

openlibrary.role: primary metadata and discovery (subject, author, ISBN lookups)
openlibrary.auth: none; send an identifying User-Agent (set FM_CONTACT_EMAIL)

rateLimit.note: keep to 1 request/second; bulk work should use the monthly data dumps instead of the API

googlebooks.role: second-source verifier for ISBN, title, author, publisher, language
googlebooks.auth: API key in GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY (free; never commit it)

rateLimit.note: default free quota; anonymous calls from the build sandbox returned quota 0

googlebooks.displayRestrictions: Do not republish Google descriptions, covers or preview content.

goodbooks10k.role: discovery only: popular-title candidate list. Its ISBNs are never trusted without a second source.
goodbooks10k.license: reported as CC BY-SA 4.0; confirm before redistribution of derived data

web-search-corroboration.role: hand verification: an ISBN is accepted only when its title and author appear together with it on at least two independent hosts

publisher-catalogs.role: authoritative per-title check when a publisher offers a public catalogue page

amazon-creators-api.status: not used. Requires qualifying sales history and credentials; see docs/AFFILIATE-AND-DEPLOYMENT.md
